Restored drafts **must never** reuse old cached `operationUuid`s from a previous session, as retrying an abandoned operationUuid could cause `DUPLICATE_OPERATION_MISMATCH` ([`AncViewModel.kt#L704`](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/state/AncViewModel.kt#L704)). Restoring a draft must assign a fresh `UUID.randomUUID().toString()`.
- **Keying New Patients**: In `StartPatientEditor` ([`AncState.kt#L454`](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/state/AncState.kt#L454)), an unsaved new patient has no database ID. Key unsaved new patient drafts with a dedicated sentinel `patient_id = "__NEW_PATIENT__"`. This naturally ensures only the most recent new patient draft is preserved.
- **Concurrency**: An autosave job executing on the IO dispatcher might race with an immediate user "Save" submission. The repository draft write must not lock Room transactions needed by `controller.save(...)`.
- **Architectural Friction**: 9 distinct draft classes have bespoke properties. Rather than 9 separate DB tables, the single polymorphic `drafts` table with `payload TEXT` and per-draft JSON encoders avoids schema bloat.

### 5. PROPOSED ROUND SPLIT
- **Round 1: Database Schema & Storage Layer**
  - Files: [`RecordsDatabase.kt`](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/storage/RecordsDatabase.kt), [`RecordEntities.kt`](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/storage/RecordEntities.kt), [`RecordsDao.kt`](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/storage/RecordsDao.kt), [`RecordsMigration.kt`](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/storage/RecordsMigration.kt), [`RecordsRepository.kt`](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/storage/RecordsRepository.kt).
  - Scope: Schema version 6 bump, `DraftEntity`, migration `from5To6`, DAO CRUD, repository methods, JSON serialization for all 9 draft types, `restoreCanonicalBackup` cleanup.
  - Verification: Unit tests (JSON serialization, migration 5->6, DAO operations on in-memory DB).
- **Round 2: Autosave Pipeline & Lifecycle Lock Flush**
  - Files: [`AncViewModel.kt`](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/state/AncViewModel.kt), [`VaultController.kt`](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/storage/VaultController.kt).
  - Scope: 1-second debounce autosave loop, synchronous flush on `manualLock()`/`onBackgrounded()`, draft deletion on `SaveCommitted`/`RecordCommitted`/`ConfirmDiscard`.
  - Verification: Unit tests (debounce timing, flush completion before lock closes database, draft deletion upon save).
- **Round 3: AncReducer State, Recovery Alert & UI Integration**
  - Files: [`AncState.kt`](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/state/AncState.kt), [`WorkspaceScreen.kt`](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/ui/WorkspaceScreen.kt), [`PatientListScreen.kt`](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/ui/PatientListScreen.kt), editor UI files, strings.xml.
  - Scope: `DraftRecoveryPrompt` state, `AcceptDraftRecovery` and `DiscardDraftRecovery` events, "Continue vs Discard" alert dialog displaying draft age and stale warnings, strings replacement for old memory-only policy.
  - Verification: Unit tests for reducer event transitions; device/emulator verification on Honor 90 for dialog presentation, backstack handling, and cold restart recovery.
